GuptaLiptonChilders2024 and MareisDrton2026 optimize costed collection, but neither profiles the persistent-confounding bridge-model components over subset-role designs.
The claimed ordering is exactly the sign of the already-defined value difference Δ_P(d,d').

novelty_flags.label: Theorem: predictive impossibility
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship comparison names CarneiroLeeWilhelm2020 but gives no section, equation, page, or quoted passage anchoring its prediction-equivalence claim; add its Section 3.2 and equations (3.4)–(3.7).

soundness_flags.label: Proposition: pairwise ordering
soundness_flags.one_line: After Δ_P(d,d′) is defined as the profiled-value difference, weak or strict dominance iff its sign is nonpositive or negative is a pure definitional restatement; move it to explanatory text or replace it with a substantive comparison result.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem: pilot oracle regret; Theorem: postselection Wald
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Pilot selection and post-selection inference are conditional on independent pilot/main samples and the stated uniform bridge-estimation and score-variance consistency rates.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The allocation-regret, studentized-normality, and Wald-coverage targets are claimed only under those high-level regularity-rate conditions; these conditions do not assume the design value or predictive-impossibility conclusion.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 gives consistency under high-level bridge-estimation conditions; Theorem 5 gives the two-source asymptotic variance under a limiting sample ratio; Theorem 7 equates that variance with the local semiparametric efficiency lower bound under unique bridges and bijective T.

For a completely randomized trial with costly covariate collection, the paper rewrites the MSE/power collection problem as minimizing residual prediction variance divided by sample size under the budget constraint.
The paper proves zero asymptotic-MSE regret for explore-then-commit and explore-then-greedy online moment-selection policies, including a cost-structure extension.
The paper derives efficiency-bound differences with and without surrogate observations and develops inference for a fixed surrogate-observation setting under unconfoundedness and missingness.
The paper studies many noisy proxies as measurements of latent surrogates and reports that regularized regression can outperform naive proxy selection in its latent-mediation model.
The paper studies multivariate additive-noise linear front-door models, derives a closed-form cost-aware partial-data sampling policy, and optimizes within an augmented influence-function class.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Delete the pairwise-ordering proposition as a solve target and retain its sign identity only as notation or an implementation note; reserve statements for a non-definitional ordering theorem.
Add the exact Carneiro–Lee–Wilhelm anchor to the flagship gap and related-work prose: Section 3.2, equations (3.4)–(3.7), with the randomized-trial residual-variance objective stated explicitly.

Turn the operator-comparison OEQ into a positive companion theorem: specify a primitive, pilot-estimable generalized-eigenvalue condition and prove a finite approximation certificate, so the impossibility result also yields a usable corrective rule.

recommended_next_step: Revise the core by removing the vacuous ordering proposition and adding a primary-source location anchor for the Carneiro–Lee–Wilhelm comparator, then continue to Stage 0 with the field-tier predictive-impossibility kernel.
